title: Academy AI Engine
intent: Provide one coherent, governable AI product contract across StarCi Academy while preserving the authorization, context, integrity, lifecycle and outcome authority of every capability that uses it.
businessValue: deliver consistent AI behavior across learning, practice, assessment and communication journeys
reduce duplicated provider, policy, retry, cost and observability behavior
prevent cross-course, cross-capability and assessment-context leakage
make AI quality, cost, safety and learning outcomes measurable per capability

actors.goal: receive useful AI assistance without losing work, privacy or learning integrity
preserve course meaning, assessment policy and authorized content use
use communication surfaces without private learning context leaking into them
control providers, quality, safety, availability, abuse and unit cost
investigate outcomes from durable, privacy-bounded provenance

capabilities.owns: course-scoped conversation continuity, explanations, translation and selected-context help
progressive hints and debugging guidance without submission or grading authority
interview conduct, rubric-bound assessment, retry and result evidence
generation of study material such as cloze, flashcards and quizzes while deterministic session logic owns scoring
typed review of authorized repository evidence and bounded learning feedback
bounded moderation, classification or summary assistance without importing Learn memory
capability-specific quality, safety, cost and regression evaluation

sharedContract: model and provider route with budget
typed output or declared streaming contract
latency, usage, cost, failure and quality observation
rules: The shared engine is a product contract, not a universal conversation, memory, grading authority or retention boundary.
Every request declares exactly one capability owner before context preparation or model execution.
Authorization is rechecked for the context used by the request; revoked or expired access cannot be hidden by cached context.
Course, enrollment, assessment, conversation and capability boundaries must not be merged implicitly.
Challenge Coach never submits learner work and never decides canonical completion or grade.
Mock Interviewer may assess only under its declared rubric and must preserve answer-linked evidence and retry identity.
Study generation may be probabilistic, but delivered session rules, accepted answers, scoring and completion are deterministic and versioned.
Global Chat remains a communication product and cannot consume private Learn conversation memory by default.
Repository, course and user-provided content are untrusted model input and cannot override platform policy or reveal hidden instructions.
A retry must not duplicate a successfully completed output, attempt, grade, usage charge or learner-visible turn.
Model and provider changes are evaluated per capability; success in one capability does not authorize rollout to another.
Fingerprint or hash metadata supplements provenance but never replaces template, rubric, context and model revisions.
AI-generated outputs disclose their nature and uncertainty where evidence or grounding is insufficient.

failures.outcome: stop new context use, preserve safe status and do not expose revoked content

failures.case: provider fails before or during output
failures.outcome: preserve accepted input and retry identity without duplicating completed work

failures.case: concurrent requests target one logical action
failures.outcome: resolve through the declared idempotency owner and return one authoritative result

failures.case: prompt injection appears in retrieved or submitted content
failures.outcome: treat the content as data, enforce platform policy and record the bounded safety outcome
reject, refresh or supersede the request rather than silently evaluating against mixed revisions

failures.case: a model route regresses on a capability case
failures.outcome: quarantine that route for the affected capability and retain the last accepted route

failures.case: cost or abuse limit is reached
failures.outcome: deny or degrade explicitly without manufacturing a successful AI result

acceptance: Every AI request identifies one capability, actor, authorization scope, context manifest and idempotency identity.
Learn Companion preserves course continuity without leaking context when courses change.
Challenge Coach supplies bounded progressive help and cannot submit or grade the challenge.
Mock Interview retry and recovery cannot create duplicate grading attempts or provider charges for one logical completion.
Study sessions score against a versioned deterministic contract even when AI generated the source material.
Global Chat AI augmentation cannot read private Learn conversation memory by default.
Outputs expose capability-appropriate provenance including context, policy, model and template or rubric revisions.
At least one resolver-level E2E path and the representative model-case matrix pass before release for each changed capability.
A broader test harness may be deferred only when the minimum release proof, authorization isolation and integrity cases remain green.
nonGoals: one universal user conversation across Academy
cross-course or cross-capability memory by default
one model or provider for every capability
AI authority over canonical enrollment, completion, score or payment state
using prompt fingerprints as security, idempotency or reproducibility proof
shipping an AI capability without a capability-specific evaluation boundary
kpis: p50 and p95 completion latency by execution mode
AI cost per successful capability outcome
launchGates: minimum resolver E2E proof for changed stateful journeys
failure, cost, latency and quality observability
openDecisions: ownership and retention store for each capability artifact
provider and model routing policy per capability
evaluation dataset ownership and promotion thresholds
which existing AI paths migrate first and how compatibility is preserved

challengeSummary.recommendation: shared governance and execution contract with bounded capability-owned products instead of a universal AI brain
